{{Quote|We rained fire on their heads, ripped their factories apart. We just need to beat down the rebels hiding out inside.|Major Tradik|<ref name="Into the Fire" />}}
'''Tradik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who fought during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]], Tradik led Imperial forces at the [[Labor Valley]] of the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] and fought rebel guerrillas during the [[Battle of Corellia]]. He allied with [[Jerris Rez]] who supplied military-grade ordnance and other weapons and [[Darbin Sull]], who wanted to be [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] next [[Prime Minister/Legends|prime minister]].
